### selected special IP addresses  {.smaller}


* loopback (current machine) --- <code>127/8</code> (v4), <code>::1/128</code> (v6)
* link-local (current network only) --- 

   * <code>169.254/16</code> (v4), <code>ff80::/10</code> (v6)

* private use (non-public networks only) --- <br> 

   * <code>192.168/16</code>, <code>172.16/12</code>, <code>10/8</code> (v4), (kinda) <code>fc00::/7</code> (v6)

* multicast groups and related --- <code>224/4</code> (v4), <code>ff00::/8</code> (v6) 

   * multiple nodes can be part of a single ‘‘multicast group’’

* broadcast (all on current network) ---  

   * <code>255.255.255.255</code>, <code>ff01::1</code>

* ‘‘future use’’ ---  

   * rest of <code>240/4</code> (v4), <code>4000::</code>---<code>efff::</code> (v6)
